question: Can a small in-process wrapper use the current upstream APIs to enforce caller-declared dimensions/pixels/allocation/work and decoded-envelope limits before affected work/allocation, without a decoder fork?
recommendation: Do not adopt either crate as an already resource-bounded scanner. rqrr has a useful bounded-output writer seam, but this is only a partial property and does not change the full-contract NO. No third candidate, implementation, decoder fork or workaround is selected.

comparative_properties.property: Caller dimensions, pixel count, raw stride/storage length before the decoder
comparative_properties.quircs: Can be prechecked by wrapper before Quirc::new/identify, including checked W*H and exact image.len; identify itself resizes before its length assertion. These are input preconditions, not a complete geometry/work/allocator proof.
comparative_properties.rqrr: Can be prechecked before public prepare_from_* constructors. Their checked_mul uses expect and then infallible allocation. ImageBuffer is not re-exported from private mod prepare, so an external no-img wrapper cannot directly implement that trait or supply its own borrowed storage through it. The img blanket implementation is separate and does not intercept internal allocations.

comparative_properties.property: Caller scratch/state allocation budget before internal growth
comparative_properties.quircs: No per-instance fallible allocator/budget API. Vec pixels/state and local flood Vec grow internally; initial capacities/hard region/capstone/grid counts are library facts, not caller limits or heap measurement. reset retains Vec capacity.
comparative_properties.rqrr: No complete per-call allocation API. Internal row_average/LruCache/flood/capstone/pair/group/location/result vectors and trial clone state have no caller byte budget. For helper-created BasicImageBuffer, derived Clone duplicates boxed pixel storage per trial; clones are temporary, not all simultaneously retained. ImageBuffer itself is not an externally exposed customization trait.

comparative_properties.property: Caller logical work/deadline/cancel bound before costly detection/ECC
comparative_properties.quircs: No budget/progress/cancel argument. identify eagerly scans and groups before yielding iterator. Geometry-derived spiral, flood revisits and fixed-iteration refinement are not charged to a caller meter; take(1) cannot undo detection.
comparative_properties.rqrr: No complete meter/cancel argument. detect_grids eagerly ranks/sorts pairs, clones trial image/cache and builds result Vec. ImageBuffer is not re-exported; even a hypothetical pixel-access meter would not cover every pair/geometry/ECC operation.

comparative_properties.property: Decoded envelope storage cap before appending output
comparative_properties.quircs: No caller-provided writer or output limit. Code::decode constructs Data.payload Vec first; per-mode logical overflow guard is8896 library bytes, not a caller envelope cap and not Vec capacity/allocator overhead. A later length rejection is too late to provide this particular pre-allocation property.
comparative_properties.rqrr: Grid::decode_to accepts std::io::Write. A future fixed-capacity writer can reject a complete write chunk before copying beyond its declared storage, and discard all partial content on ANY error. Convenience decode instead collects Vec/String. This is source feasibility only, no wrapper implemented/tested.

comparative_properties.property: Intrinsic QR workspace/retries, separate from caller budgets
comparative_properties.quircs: Regions stop at65534 entries including reserved entries; capstones32/grids8; Code bitmap3917bytes; Datastream two8896byte arrays. Version1..40 and grid-size congruence checked before data read; format read tries at most two locations. Counts are library facts, not caller budget or target stack/heap measurements.
comparative_properties.rqrr: LRU cache251 is not a whole-state cap; RawData/CorrectedDataStream each contain8896byte arrays. Version::from_size checks computed version1..40, not all public BitGrid geometry preconditions. Normal raw/ECC then one mirrored attempt; writer payload processing follows, so writer failure does not restart mirrored output. Target live storage/stack unmeasured.

comparative_properties.quircs: Unchecked width*height precedes allocation; signed geometric products/casts and unchecked pixel accesses remain in implementation. Caller size/length checks are necessary but not a proof of every derived geometry precondition. No panic/overflow/exploit was executed here.
comparative_properties.rqrr: Checked helper W*H panics on overflow, infallible Vec growth; additional unchecked arithmetic, SimpleGrid size*size, geometric assertions and io errors are distinct. catch_unwind/timeouts are not recoverable allocation/work caps and do not stop an uncooperative synchronous call by themselves. No vulnerability reproduction claimed.
